summary.text: Dana Henry is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 100, representing Orleans, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2026 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Dana Henry's occupation as Attorney.
It lists Dana Henry's education as Juris Doctorate.
The House member page lists Dana Henry's committee assignments as Insurance; Municipal, Parochial and Cultural Affairs; Transportation, Highways and Public Works.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Democratic Caucus; Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus; Orleans Delegation.
